name: Glamour

components.pose: He stands relaxed but coiled, weight on one leg, head tilted slightly, an intense, knowing gaze toward the camera and a sly half-smile.
components.wearing: close-fitting Toxic Orchid Magenta-toned light leather armor, Tarnished Brass accent straps across the chest and hips, built for silent movement; faint venom-etched tattoos visible at the collarbone, a serpent-coil clasp at the shoulder
components.effects: A few faint tendrils of {{MAGIC}} mist curl near his boots, glowing softly - understated, nothing busy.

notes: Daily-post glamour shot: signature armor, coiled confident stance, element-matched background, light magic only.
